binding_note: The zone-on-Cloudflare requirement is the write gate reached before any byte. On a transfer the first first-party limit is the 100 MB proxied request body cap (413 beyond it); the 125 s read and 30 s write proxy timeouts also apply, and no transit byte quota is published.
interface_detail: cloudflared tunnel run; the hostname is a record on a zone owned by the account
limits_note: counts of things, not rates, so no vocabulary kind names them: 1,000 cloudflared tunnels per account and 25 active replicas per tunnel; 50,000 routes per account, shared with Cloudflare Mesh
